patterns: APPSC asks direct one-liners: Sir Creek dispute = India-Pakistan; IWT broker = World Bank; Simla = Indira-Bhutto; 1965 was not the first Kashmir war.
Recurring traps: Tashkent vs Simla (which created LoC), Karachi vs Simla, Lahore (Nawaz Sharif) vs Agra (Musharraf), and chronological order of treaties.
Article 370 is asked as polity (which Article gives special status / applies on its own) rather than as foreign relations.
App leans on multi-statement items and 2025-26 current affairs (Operation Sindoor, IWT abeyance, PCA ruling) far beyond what PYQs show; PYQs are short single-fact items.
Likely APPSC shapes: river allocation under IWT (eastern = India), Operation names (Meghdoot, Vijay, Parakram) and terror-attack/response pairs.
